notes: Get Song and Find on Spotify now use Spotify search directly through a secure PKCE sign-in. After authorizing once, SideCut copies the real open.spotify.com track or album share URL to your clipboard instead of copying a search-results page or sending you to Spotify’s app.
No Spotify client secret is stored in SideCut. The access token stays on this device and is reused until it expires, while the existing Spotify handoff remains available if the API is unavailable.
